qualification_subject: A separately supplied implementation under a fixed installation and configuration profile

gates.title: Local business contracts have enough meaning to implement
gates.acceptance_measure: Look up a source declaration, identify its release and reconstruct a named decision.
gates.open_qualification: Catalogue entries with no reviewed decision still need per-branch review where the replacement implements them.

gates.title: Identity, amount, date and unit meanings remain stable
gates.acceptance_measure: Preserve child identities, link targets, accounting currency and stock unit through a conversion.
gates.open_qualification: Site-defined fields, conversions and currencies require a captured configuration.

gates.title: Company, record and field authority apply to every entry path
gates.acceptance_measure: Compare allowed and denied reads under ordinary actors and an elevated actor; retain company and field scopes.
gates.open_qualification: Repeat under every supported interface, app composition and real role set in the deployment profile.

gates.title: Lifecycle and synchronous consequences are indivisible
gates.acceptance_measure: Check document events, rollback and which side effects may start after commit.
gates.open_qualification: Interrupt during multi-voucher work, then reconcile pending work and financial effects.

gates.title: Domains use shared authoritative master identities
gates.acceptance_measure: Retain customer, party, item, warehouse and original row identity across applications.
gates.open_qualification: Exercise simultaneous party creation, merge and overlapping externally supplied identifiers.

gates.title: Every financial event balances and retains its original context
gates.acceptance_measure: Match the expense and stock reversal on a physical return and the separately applied commercial credit.
gates.open_qualification: Repeat with multicurrency, closed periods, immutable reversals and a backdated valuation adjustment.

gates.title: Prices, taxes, units and commitments preserve exact decisions
gates.acceptance_measure: Distinguish the source order quantity, delivered quantity, billed quantity, credit, settlement and tax base.
gates.open_qualification: Exercise partial fulfilment across tax regimes, currency precisions and returns on previously discounted lines.

gates.title: Physical quantity, reservations and valuation reconcile
gates.acceptance_measure: Issue stock from the configured layer, preserve identity-specific rates, and update downstream cost after a correction.
gates.open_qualification: Competing issues, reservations and reposts must agree under the database isolation policy chosen for the rebuild.

gates.title: Claims, advances, bank and exchange effects remain distinct
gates.acceptance_measure: Follow settlement by original voucher including a stale partial credit with a zero party balance and offsetting open items.
gates.open_qualification: Verify the larger bank allocation, write-off, chargeback and exchange difference sets.

gates.title: Recognition, valuation, assets, budgets and closing qualify together
gates.acceptance_measure: Reconcile a period journal to four reports and import asset cost, including material and previously capitalized components.
gates.open_qualification: Qualify period close, cancellation, localized reporting and group translation on the target site.

gates.title: Material, output and financial cost reconcile through production
gates.acceptance_measure: Balance component consumption, manufacturing output, secondary products, disassembly and outsourced conversion.
gates.open_qualification: Test multiple concurrent work orders, capacity exceptions, cross-currency supplier charges and split operations.

gates.title: Employment, calendars, salary and employee settlement share accounting
gates.acceptance_measure: Carry check-in and leave evidence to payroll, employer accrual, employee advances and loan recovery.
gates.open_qualification: Run a representative full payroll period including retroactive leave, separation and reversal under the chosen local policy.

gates.title: Commercial identity, project billing and service obligations integrate
gates.acceptance_measure: Trace service deadlines, working calendars, time billing and a CRM deal converted into ERP commercial documents.
gates.open_qualification: Qualify calendar exceptions, remote handoff recovery and private party records across the installed products.

gates.title: Configured behavior uses the same business and permission contracts
gates.acceptance_measure: Resolve effective document types, hooks, public operations, report metadata and permission overrides for a declared app order.
gates.open_qualification: Run each contracted transport shape and failure outcome against that exact installed composition.

gates.title: One mixed-pack trading sequence reconciles every shared history
gates.acceptance_measure: Run the full linked receipt, repack, ship, return and settlement scenario and compare normalized observations.
gates.open_qualification: A candidate must submit the sequence using its own implementation and independently read it back.

gates.title: Competing operations cannot spend or publish the same remainder twice
gates.acceptance_measure: Name the competing claims, transaction boundaries and accepted serial outcomes for events and inventory.
gates.open_qualification: Record two-worker interleavings and final ledger/queue outcomes on the selected replacement.

gates.title: External work has durable identity and an explicit recovery boundary
gates.acceptance_measure: Distinguish confirmed remote effects, ambiguous timeouts, duplicate callbacks and locally unapplied payments.
gates.open_qualification: Collect provider sandbox or controlled emulator receipts before and after duplicates, retries and interrupted reconciliation.

gates.title: Restart and restore preserve durable business meaning
gates.acceptance_measure: Associate a database backup and public/private files with the same logical tenant and recovery point.
gates.open_qualification: Verify outstanding jobs, remote acknowledgements, transaction logs and recovery objectives for the intended deployment.

gates.title: Reports are explainable projections of effective history
gates.acceptance_measure: Compare trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet and cash reports with the underlying movements and entity scopes.
gates.open_qualification: Qualify permissions, dynamic columns, presentation filters and date boundaries for the reports the replacement supports.

gates.title: Complete integrated scope has executed conformance and recovery evidence
gates.acceptance_measure: Assemble a dated app and policy manifest, close the applicable predecessor gates and retain comparison evidence.
gates.open_qualification: No replacement implementation has been supplied. Unpinned apps, private customizations and live external counterpart configurations require independent evidence.
